en.sayyid-mohsen-al-husayni-al-milani: 2. My father, Muḥammad ibn Ḥasan, and ‘Ali ibn Ḥusain all narrated to me from Sa’d, from Aḥmad ibn Muḥammad ibn ‘Isā, from Rizqillāh ibn ‘Alā, from Sulaymān ibn ‘Amr Al-Sarrāj, from some of our companions, who said: Abū ‘Abdillāh (Imam Sādiq (a.s.)) said:
The clay of the grave of Ḥusain (a.s.) can be collected from up to a distance of seventy fathoms from the grave.
